t: Hannitzrak linqabayv vedin rechitza ushear hakanot
s: Hannitzrak linqabayv vedin rechitza ushear hakanot ubo y' seipim: gupo ketzad? Haya tzarik linqabayv al yitpallel ad sheyyippaneh, mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon liqrat eloheka yisrael". Veim hitpallel — tepillato toeba vetzarik lachazor ulehitpallel. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bigdolim, abal biqtannim — en tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel. Vaapillu bigdolim eno tzarik lachazor ella kesheeno yakol lehaamid atzmo shiur hilluk parsa, abal im yakol lehaamid atzmo shiur hilluk parsa — yatza bediabad. Abal lekattechilla lo yitpallel begup meshuqqatz, apillu im yaabor zeman hattepilla ad sheyyippaneh. Vaapillu bedibre tora asur kol zeman sheggupo meshuqqatz. Veyesh mi shemmattir apillu lekattechilla im yakol lehaamid atzmo shiur parsa. Veyesh lismok al zeh im hu beinyan shebbeod sheyyippaneh yaabor zeman hattepilla:

Vekol zeh keshehutzrak qodem hatchalat hattepilla, abal im beemtza tepillato nitorer lo taava ben liqtannim ben ligdolim, im yakol lehaamid atzmo ad sheyyesayyem tepillato — yaamid atzmo velo yapsiq apillu liqtannim beemtza tepillat y"ch. Veim eno yakol lehaamid atzmo — yapsiq ligdolim, abal liqtannim lo yapsiq. Vaapillu mayim shotetin al birkayv — mamtin ad sheyyiklu hammayim vechozer litpillato, veen tzarik leharchiq, kemo shennitbaer besiman a"ch. Abal beemtza qeriat shema ubirkoteha, im ratza — marchiq umetil mayim, veim ratza — qore kedarko umaamid atzmo ad sheyyesayyem tepillato. Abal ligdolim tzarik lehaamid atzmo im yakol velo yapsiq apillu biqriat shema ubirkoteha (o apillu bipsuqe dezimra mi"baruk sheamar" veelak). Vehu sheeno mitavveh kol kak beinyan sheyyehe bo mishshum "bal teshaqqetzu" keshemmaamid atzmo, ap al pi sheeno yakol lehaamid atzmo shiur parsa, abal im hu beinyan sheyyesh bo mishshum "bal teshaqqetzu" — mapsiq ben liqtannim ben ligdolim beemtza qeriat shema ubirkoteha, abal lo beemtza tepillat y"ch, shello hittiru lehapsiq beemtza tepillat y"ch ella mishshum chashash sakkanat nepashot bilbad ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"d, veqal vachomer mishshum issur "bal teshaqqetzu" sheeno ella middibre soperim, shehem ameru vehem ameru (veim merob dochqo nitattesh o shebbiqqesh lehitattesh — yitbaer besiman (qy"g) [q"g]):

Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yibdoq et atzmo yapeh qodem hattepilla shello yitztarek linqabayv achar kak veyittared bitpillato. Veken yasir kicho venio vekol dabar hattoredo. Veachar kak tzarik lirchotz yadayv bammayim ap al pi shennotel yadayv shacharit, kevan shennaga betinnopet achar netilat shacharit. Umikkol maqom, lo yebarek al rechitza zo im kebar berak al netilat shacharit, mittaam shennitbaer besiman z':

Veim en lo mayim — tzarik lachazor acharehem ad parsa im hu badderek vehammayim nimtzaim lepanayv berichuq parsa veyakol lehaggia alehen qodem sheyyaabor zeman hattepilla. Vehu sheholek yechidi, abal im holek beshayyara — en tzarik lehippared min hashshayyara laleket yechidi limqom hammayim. Veim tzarik lachazor laachorayv limqom mayim ad mil — chozer, yoter mimmil — eno tzarik lachazor. Veim mityare shemma yaabor zeman hattepilla ad sheyyaggia limqom hammayim — lo yachazor acharehem kelal, raq yenaqqeh yadayv bitzror o beapar o beqora o bekol dabar shemmenaqqeh:

Vekol zeh kesheyyadayv meluklakot o shennageu bemaqom metunnap, abal im eno yodea lahen shum likluk ap al pi shehissiach dato mehem achar netilat shacharit — en tzarik lachazor velittelan velo lenaqqotan, shessetam yadayim kesherot litpilla kemo shekkesherot lishar berakot. Veyesh omerim shehessach haddaat posel litpilla kemo shepposel laakila, mippene shehayyadayim asqaniyyot hen veshemma nageu bimqom hattinnopet. Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, im en mayim mezummanim lepanayv — en tzarik lachazor acharehem im eno yodea lahem shum likluk, shelleinyan zeh yesh lismok al sebara harishona, ella yenaqqeh yadayv bekol dabar shemmenaqqeh, shenniqqayon moil ap leyadayim shel hessach haddaat, sheppesul hessach haddaat hu mishshum shemma mudbaq bahen meat zea o tzoa, ukeshemmenaqqeh yitqannechu. Vaapillu beyadayim meluklakot — en tzarik lachazor achar mayim ella kesheepshar, abal kesheomed bitpilla shei epshar lazuz mimmeqomo venizkar shennaga bemaqom metunnap — day beniqyon apar o tzerorot, o mechakkek yadayv bakkotel. Abal lekattechilla asur ligga bemaqom metunnap (apillu yesh lo mayim mezummanim lepanayv, shello lehapsiq) battepilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"z:
Vekol zeh bitpilla, abal letalmud tora day beniqqayon bealma bekol inyan, apillu yesh mayim mezummanim lepanayv:

Maqom hamtunnap hem meqomot hamkussim baadam, lepi sheyyesh bahem milmule zea. Veken im chikkek harosh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"d. Veken tzoat haozen vetzoat haap hen tinnopot, veasur ligga bahen battepilla ki im al yede beged:

Hammashtin lo yitpallel ad sheyyishheh kede hilluk d' ammot, mishshum nitzotzot shebbeammato. Vehammitpallel lo yashtin ad sheyyishheh kede hilluk d' ammot achar siyyum tepillato, shekkol d' ammot tepillato shegura bepiv usepatayv rochashot. Abal leachar sheshshaha kede hilluk d' ammot — muttar lo lehashtin bammaqom shehitpallel. Umiddat chasidut shello lehashtin betok d' ammot shel tepilla:

Haroqeq lo yitpallel ad sheyyishheh kede hilluk d' ammot. Vehammitpallel lo yaroq lirtzono mechamat tiyyul ad sheyyishheh kede hilluk d' ammot. Abal im nizdammen lo roq — muttar apillu betok hattepilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"z:
Tob litten tzedaqa qodem hattepilla, shenneemar: "ani betzedeq echezeh paneka":
